title: Navigate through Enigmatic Labyrinth A Survey of Chain of Thought Reasoning: Advances, Frontiers and Future
best_for_zh: 想在阅读具体方法前先建立思维链研究全景的读者。
one_line: An ACL 2024 survey that organizes chain-of-thought reasoning methods, current frontiers, and open questions.
系统梳理思维链推理的方法、研究前沿、挑战与开放问题。
why: It helps distinguish a reasoning-chain technique from the task, evidence, and limitation with which it is reported.
inclusion_reason: An accepted ACL survey that makes chain-of-thought research easier to read as a connected set of methods, evidence, and unresolved questions.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Chain-of-thought prompting has attracted attention because it can improve language-model performance on reasoning tasks, but the associated literature spans many methods and questions. This ACL 2024 paper systematically investigates that literature and organizes it for readers. It is a survey rather than a release of a new model or training set.

The decision boundary is important: this paper helps a reader understand how prior work describes reasoning chains, but it does not establish that a visible chain is correct, faithful, or needed for every task. Read it when choosing among reported approaches or interpreting a claim about chain-of-thought, not when you need a ready-made training recipe or a common benchmark result.

思维链提示因能提升语言模型在推理任务上的表现而受到关注，但相关文献覆盖了许多方法和问题。这篇 ACL 2024 论文系统调查这些研究，并为读者整理结构。它是综述，不发布新模型或训练集。

边界要明确：本文帮助理解已有工作如何描述推理链，却不证明可见链条必然正确、忠实，或每项任务都需要它。它适合用来选择已报告的方法或解释相关主张；若需要可直接采用的训练配方或统一基准结果，应查阅原始研究。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The survey's central organizing device is a taxonomy of advanced chain-of-thought research. It combines that taxonomy with a discussion of current frontiers, challenges, future directions, and open questions. For readers, this makes it easier to ask whether two papers change the same part of a reasoning setup or merely share a familiar label.

The taxonomy separates the object being changed from the outcome being reported. A paper may alter the prompt, the form of intermediate reasoning, the task, or the evaluation, and those choices answer different questions. Keeping these dimensions visible prevents a reader from treating a result in one setting as evidence of an unrestricted capability improvement.

综述的核心组织工具是对先进思维链研究的分类法。它把这一分类与研究前沿、挑战、未来方向和开放问题结合起来。对读者而言，这有助于判断两篇论文是否改变了同一部分推理设置，还是仅仅共享一个常见名称。

分类法把“被改变的对象”与“被报告的结果”分开。论文可能改变提示、过程文本形式、任务或评测；这些选择回答不同问题。保持这些维度清晰，能避免把某一设置中的结果误读为不受限制的能力提升。

title: Method
方法
html:
As a survey, the paper investigates prior research and summarizes methods through a taxonomy. Its useful units of analysis are a prompt, an intermediate reasoning chain, a target task, and the evaluation result associated with that setup. The linked resource collection supports readers who want to trace the summarized work back to its sources.

For each cited result, reconstruct the smallest comparable record: what the model receives, what intermediate text it produces, what answer is scored, and under which task conditions it is scored. That record makes the high-level organization actionable and prevents a chain format from being mistaken for evidence about training data, sampling choices, or verification.

作为综述，论文调查既有研究，并用分类法总结方法。它的有用分析单位包括提示、中间推理链、目标任务，以及与该设置相连的评测结果。链接的资源集合帮助读者回溯被总结工作的原始来源。

对每项被引结果，应还原最小可比记录：模型收到什么、生成什么过程文本、哪一个答案被评分、在什么任务条件下评分。这会使高层结构变得可操作，也避免把链条格式误当成关于训练数据、采样选择或核验的证据。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper supports its account by systematically gathering relevant research, not by introducing one new score. Its abstract states that chain-of-thought prompting has been found to improve reasoning capability and that the paper surveys advanced methods. When comparing cited claims, retain the original task and evaluation conditions because the papers can study different problems.

Its evidence therefore describes the shape of the literature and the range of reported findings, rather than a pooled experiment in which every method uses the same model and protocol. Check the cited study when an improvement matters: it may concern final answers, the form of intermediate output, or both, and those claims have different practical implications.

论文通过系统汇集相关研究来支撑其叙述，而不是引入单一新分数。摘要指出，既有研究发现思维链提示能提升推理能力，论文据此调查先进方法。比较被引用的结论时，应保留原始任务和评测条件，因为它们研究的问题可能不同。

所以，这里的证据描述的是文献结构与已报告发现的范围，而不是让所有方法在同一模型、同一协议下竞争的汇总实验。当某个提升对你很重要时，应回到原始研究：它可能针对最终答案、过程输出形式，或两者兼有，实际含义并不相同。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Its novelty is a detailed taxonomy and a unified discussion of advances, frontiers, challenges, and unresolved questions. It does not present a single new chain-of-thought technique. The paper is most valuable as a shared vocabulary for locating an individual result within the broader research landscape.

The contribution changes how papers can be compared rather than changing a model's behavior directly. It lets readers place a proposed method beside related prompt-based work, identify shared assumptions, and notice whether apparent novelty is mainly a change in presentation or task setup. This distinction is useful when deciding what is worth reproducing or extending.

它的新意在于细致的分类法，以及对进展、前沿、挑战和未解问题的统一讨论。论文不提出单一新的思维链技术。它最有价值的地方，是为读者提供共同词汇，把个别结果放回更大的研究图景。

这项贡献改变的是比较论文的方式，而非直接改变模型行为。它让读者把新方法放到相关提示工作旁，识别共享假设，并判断表面新意是否主要是呈现方式或任务设置的变化。这对决定复现什么、扩展什么很有帮助。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The survey spans studies with different models, prompts, tasks, and measurements, so its summaries do not make every result directly interchangeable. A stronger reported score can reflect a changed task setup as well as a changed reasoning method. Use the taxonomy to narrow a comparison and then read the underlying experiment for its exact conditions.

An intermediate chain can also be readable without reliably explaining why an answer was produced. The survey reports heterogeneous evidence, not a universal test of reasoning faithfulness. If a use case depends on dependable intermediate reasoning, the primary study's checks and failure cases matter more than the mere presence of a chain in its outputs.

综述覆盖的研究使用不同模型、提示、任务和测量方式，因此它的总结不会让每个结果天然可以互换。更高的分数可能同时反映任务设置变化和推理方法变化。先用分类法缩小比较范围，再查看原始实验的具体条件。

过程链可读，也未必可靠解释答案为何产生。本文报告的是异质证据，并非对推理忠实性的通用检验。若场景依赖可信的中间推理，原始研究中的检查和失败案例比输出中是否出现链条更值得关注。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this paper before choosing or evaluating a chain-of-thought approach. It helps turn a broad interest in reasoning chains into focused questions about method family, task, evidence, and open limitation. The resource list is useful when a reader needs the primary papers behind a branch of the taxonomy.

It works well at the beginning of a literature review or experiment design. Use the categories to make a shortlist, then select primary papers whose tasks and measurements match your question. The survey is not proof that a method will transfer to a new task; it identifies the conditions that must be checked before such a transfer claim is credible.

在选择或评估思维链方法之前，可以先使用这篇论文。它能把对推理链的宽泛兴趣转成关于方法类别、任务、证据和开放限制的聚焦问题。当读者需要分类某一分支背后的原始论文时，资源列表也很有用。

它适合作为文献综述或实验设计的起点。先用类别建立短名单，再选择任务和度量与你的问题相符的原始论文。本文不是某方法必然迁移到新任务的证明，而是指出此类主张可信前必须核对的条件。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the taxonomy first, then the sections on frontiers and challenges. For each method that interests you, record the task it targets and whether the cited evidence concerns answer quality, reasoning behavior, or both. The open-question discussion is a useful reminder that a visible chain is not by itself a complete explanation.

Add the model and prompt conditions used by each primary study, plus the comparison it actually makes. This simple template distinguishes a result in one prompt setting from a result about a whole method family. Treat the future-directions discussion as a set of questions to verify in source papers, rather than as completed empirical findings.

建议先读分类法，再读前沿与挑战部分。对每个感兴趣的方法，记下它面向的任务，以及被引用证据讨论的是答案质量、推理行为，还是两者兼有。开放问题部分提醒读者：可见的推理链本身并不等于完整解释。

还应记录每项原始研究所用的模型、提示条件，以及它实际比较了什么。这个简单模板可区分某一提示设置的结果和整个方法家族的结论。把未来方向视为需在原始文献中核对的问题，而非已经完成的实证发现。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Zheng Chu, Jingchang Chen, Qianglong Chen, Weijiang Yu, Tao He, Haotian Wang, Weihua Peng, Ming Liu, Bing Qin, and Ting Liu. 2024. Navigate through Enigmatic Labyrinth A Survey of Chain of Thought Reasoning: Advances, Frontiers and Future. ACL 2024 Long Papers, pages 1173–1203. https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.65/

Use the ACL Anthology record as the authoritative entry for title, authorship, venue, pages, and DOI; it also links the paper and the authors' resource collection. When citing a concrete method or empirical result mentioned here, cite that primary study as well. This survey is the source for taxonomy and synthesis, not for a new shared experiment.

Zheng Chu、Jingchang Chen、Qianglong Chen 等。2024。《Navigate through Enigmatic Labyrinth A Survey of Chain of Thought Reasoning: Advances, Frontiers and Future》。ACL 2024 Long Papers，1173–1203 页。https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.65/

标题、作者、会议、页码和 DOI 应以 ACL Anthology 条目为准；该条目还链接论文和作者的资源集合。引用本文提到的具体方法或实证结果时，也应引用相应原始研究。本文提供的是分类与综合，不是一个新的统一实验。
